p: host of them: That is, the innumerable abundance of creatures in heaven and earth.
rested on the seventh day from: For he had now finished his creation, but his providence still watches over his creatures and governs them.
sanctified it: Appointed it to be kept holy, that man might in it consider the excellency of his works and God's goodness toward him.
rain upon the earth: God only opens the heavens and shuts them, he sends drought and rain according to his good pleasure.
of the dust of the ground: He shows what man's body was created from, to the intent that man should not glory in the excellency of his own nature.
Eden: This was the name of a place, as some think in Mesopotamia, most pleasant and abundant in all things.
tree of life also in the: Who was a sign of the life received from God.
and the tree of knowledge of: That is, of miserable experience, which came by disobeying God.
of Havilah: Havilah is a country adjoining Persia to the east, and inclining towards the west.
dress it and to keep it: God would not have man idle, though as yet there was no need to labour.
commanded the man: So that man might know there was a sovereign Lord, to whom he owed obedience.
die: By death he means the separation of man from God, who is our life and chief happiness: and also that our disobedience is the cause of it.
Adam to see what he would: By moving them to come and submit themselves to Adam.
woman: Signifying that mankind was perfect, when the woman was created, who before was like an imperfect building.
his father and his mother: So marriage requires a greater duty of us toward our wives, than otherwise we are bound to show to our parents.
ashamed: For before sin entered, all things were honest and comely.
